footer-2: This website was created as part of an academic project, focusing on web development and applications.
am-description: I am a developer focused on game development and full-stack web applications in Java. I have experience building complete systems, from back-end logic to functional, well-structured front-end interfaces. In game development, I work with gameplay logic, graphics systems, and optimization, always aiming for performance and clean code organization. In web development, I use Java to build robust applications, with attention to scalability, maintainability, and good architectural practices. I am constantly interested in improving my technical skills, especially in areas such as computer graphics, data structures, and software engineering.
p-sk-d: Face hordes of enemies, defeat bosses, run through enemies, and push them off buildings in this shield-themed roguelite.
p-rv-d: Command an army of Viking dwarves and lead them to victory! Give them new weapons and armor, choose a village to raid, and watch them destroy everything, grow stronger, and repeat the process! How far can you go?
p-sm-d: SokoMage is a new top-down puzzle game that will push your brain to the limit. Hit rocks, avoid bushes, and strike the crystal to reach the end! Can you make your way to the final level?
p-s3-d: A game inspired by the classic Snake, recreated in a 3D environment with dynamic movement.
p-kc-d: A terrible curse has fallen upon the king, and only you can help him! Embark on a journey where you must face three powerful villains to free the king from his curse. Defeat them all and earn the reward for your bravery.
p-vp-d: Play with your pet to earn coins and customize your home to reflect your style, with a few minigames. Don't forget to care for your pet by feeding it, bathing it, and giving it plenty of rest.
p-s-d: Face powerful bosses in intense strategic battles, where each fight requires skill and planning to defeat the enemy.
